of "re-identifying" the patient with his/her own self and with the analyst as a separate object.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the "trauma" is not the cause of the malaise but rather an obstacle to the development of a mature personality and the ability to form relationships with others.
the trauma child is not a diagnosis of trauma but rather an indication of an arrested developmental process.

the "trauma" child is not the victim of a particular traumatic event, but rather a child whose psychic development has become blocked, who is stuck in a regressive mode and is incapable of moving forward.
